outcomes.note: ROUND 2 EXISTS FOR THIS OUTCOME. Round 1 graded it FAILED on judgment -- the governance token carried two intents -- and five of round 2's six cells serve it. WHAT CHANGED: IAM-r-1 split the token into DECLARED / ADOPT / EXEMPT with the rule-24 four-postulate record; IAM-r-3 measured TRUE membership PER MEMBER on Terraform SOURCE, classing by resource-block presence and never by name mention, and found 1 DECLARED-IN-TF (the confirmed false positive seeking-alpha-scraper-role) and 15 NOT-IN-TF, so THE SETTLED SET OF 16 IS 15; IAM-r-4 recorded the CTO's class ruling against all three AWS service-default roles as ONE decision, taking UNASSIGNED member rows 6 -> 3 on a constant denominator of 16; IAM-r-5 declared both production serving-path roles and PROVED adoption non-destructive (Plan: 2 to import, 0 to add, 2 to change, 0 to DESTROY, both update-in-place on inherited provider default_tags), with a baseline No-changes plan taken FIRST so the delta is attributable, and nothing applied; IAM-r-6 extended the axis with RETIRE and disposed lambda-test-role. CLAIM IS COVERAGE, NOT A GRADE. done_when is APPLIED and the state reached is APPLIED: every one of the 16 is now in code or carries a named owner and a reason. TWO THINGS THE GRADER SHOULD NOT HAVE TO FIND. (1) IAM-r-6's AC1 and AC3 CANNOT FAIL and must not be credited -- AC1's 'measured 0 at the cut' is true only of a case-SENSITIVE instrument while the criterion ships -i, and the document read 3 at the cut; the discriminating measurement the cell actually passes is the case-sensitive word-boundary census, 0 at the parent commit and 17 at the cell's own HEAD, so the hollow bars did NOT hide a no-op. Carried as rows Z-S11 (this lane, filed against its own issuance) and Z-W5-S1 (the worker, independently). (2) IAM-r-5's verbatim-quote bound and its AC5 are MUTUALLY UNSATISFIABLE as written -- terraform's own plan footer emits the string 'terraform apply' unprompted -- and the worker resolved it by rendering with terraform show and proving completeness with an empty diff against the raw plan region. Row Z-W6-S3. Both defects are this issuer's.
